releases.name: opencode-plan-canvas-plugin plugin-v0.3.1
releases.body:
## opencode-plan-canvas-plugin v0.3.1

Bug fix. In `0.3.0` the message relay was delivered, but the **canvas showed no prompt UI** in the normal plugin-driven flow — so there was no way to actually send a message. This release fixes that.

### The bug

When the plugin auto-spawned the watch server, it launched `watch <plan> --port <port>` **without** `--enable-messaging`. The result: the canvas had no prompt box and no `POST /prompt` endpoint, so the outbox relay (which does work) had nothing to receive. The delivery half was enabled in `0.3.0`; the UI half was not.

### The fix

The plugin now appends `--enable-messaging` to the spawn command **by default**, so the prompt bar and per-task "send message" button appear automatically.

- **`enableMessaging?: boolean`** added to `AdapterConfig` (default `true`). Set `false` to spawn a read-only canvas with no prompt UI.
- **`OPENCODE_PLAN_CANVAS_NO_MESSAGING`** env opt-out (env beats config), mirroring the existing `OPENCODE_PLAN_CANVAS_NO_SPAWN` pattern — so users of the plain `@latest` string form can disable it without a custom factory.
- Only affects servers the plugin **spawns**; an already-running server is just nudged, not reconfigured.

### Upgrade note

opencode caches `@latest` plugins and does not re-resolve on a plain restart. After upgrading, clear the cache and restart:

```sh
rm -rf ~/.cache/opencode/packages/opencode-plan-canvas-plugin@latest
# then restart opencode
```

Pairs with [`opencode-plan-canvas@0.2.0`](https://github.com/zoispag/opencode-plan-canvas/releases/tag/v0.2.0) (unchanged). Published to npm with provenance via OIDC trusted publishing.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/zoispag/opencode-plan-canvas/compare/plugin-v0.3.0...plugin-v0.3.1

releases.name: opencode-plan-canvas-plugin plugin-v0.3.0
releases.body:
## opencode-plan-canvas-plugin v0.3.0

Adds a **message relay**: when the watch server runs with `--enable-messaging`, this plugin delivers prompts you send from the canvas into your active opencode session. This is the piece that makes the new canvas → agent channel actually reach the agent.

### What's new

- **Outbox watcher.** On the first watched plan/boulder event, the plugin starts watching `<root>/.sisyphus/outbox` (`fs.watch` + a slow poll fallback, mirroring the existing plan watcher).
- **Delivery to the right session.** For each queued message it picks the most recently active **top-level** session (via `client.session.list()`), skipping background subagent/child sessions, and forwards the text as a user prompt with `client.session.promptAsync`. Task-scoped messages are prefixed with the task id for context.
- **At-least-once, self-healing.** A message file is deleted only after a successful send. If no session is available yet, or the send fails, it stays queued and retries. Malformed files are dropped; messages older than ~10 minutes are skipped so a stale prompt from a previous session never lands in a fresh one.
- **Clean lifecycle.** The watcher is closed on `dispose` and on process-exit, alongside any spawned server.

### Unchanged guarantees

- The package entry still exports **only** the default Plugin factory.
- **Zero runtime dependencies** — `@opencode-ai/plugin` remains a type-only devDependency; the SDK client is accessed through a minimal local structural interface, not a runtime import.

### Pairs with

[`opencode-plan-canvas@0.2.0`](https://github.com/zoispag/opencode-plan-canvas/releases/tag/v0.2.0), which adds the `--enable-messaging` flag and the `POST /prompt` endpoint that queues messages.

### Upgrade note

opencode caches `@latest` plugins and does not re-resolve on a plain restart. After upgrading, clear the cache and restart:

```sh
rm -rf ~/.cache/opencode/packages/opencode-plan-canvas-plugin@latest
# then restart opencode
```

Published to npm with provenance via OIDC trusted publishing.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/zoispag/opencode-plan-canvas/compare/plugin-v0.2.2...plugin-v0.3.0
